total_endorsements.label: A · Total endorsements
total_endorsements.doc: A: every distinct endorsement adds to the boost.

community_capped.label: B · Capped endorsements per community
community_capped.doc: B: endorsements beyond `cap` from the same community stop adding boost.

diminishing.label: D · Diminishing returns per community (√eᵢ)
diminishing.doc: Each community's support counts with diminishing returns: sum of sqrt(e_i).

breadth_bonus.label: E · Total + bonus for cross-community support
breadth_bonus.doc: Keep total endorsements, but add +1 for every community beyond the first that endorsed.

bridging.label: T · Bridging (Törnberg et al. 2023-style)
bridging.doc: Törnberg et al. 2023-style: only endorsements from OTHER communities count.

scenarios.title: Concentrated, coordinated cluster
scenarios.question: Main test: a tight cluster inside one community endorses nearly every antisemitic post it sees. This is the situation the cap is designed for.

summary.label: A · Total endorsements
summary.verdict: baseline

summary.label: B · Capped endorsements per community
summary.verdict: reduces exposure, below target; keeps ordinary engagement; costs counterspeech

summary.label: D · Diminishing returns per community (√eᵢ)
summary.verdict: reduces exposure, below target; keeps ordinary engagement; costs counterspeech

summary.label: E · Total + bonus for cross-community support
summary.verdict: reduces exposure, below target; keeps ordinary engagement; keeps counterspeech

summary.label: T · Bridging (Törnberg et al. 2023-style)
summary.verdict: meets harm-reduction target; keeps ordinary engagement; costs counterspeech
